title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 21 日

stories.headline_en: Fans Queue Overnight for Pokemon Stamps at Taipei World Exhibition
stories.headline_zh: 臺北世界郵展登場 粉絲漏夜排隊搶購寶可夢郵票

sentences.en: Hundreds of fans waited in long lines overnight at the Taipei World Trade Center.
sentences.zh: 數百名粉絲在臺北世貿中心外漏夜排起長龍。

sentences.en: They hoped to buy special Pokemon stamps and gifts at a world stamp exhibition.
sentences.zh: 他們希望在世界郵展上購買特別版的寶可夢郵票與聯名商品。

sentences.en: Chunghwa Post created these colorful designs to attract younger people to stamp collecting.
sentences.zh: 中華郵政推出這些繽紛的設計，希望能吸引年輕世代投入集郵。

sentences.en: The free exhibition runs until November 25 and displays rare stamps from around seventy regions.
sentences.zh: 這場免費展覽將持續至十一月二十五日，並展出約七十個國家與地區的珍貴郵票。

stories.headline_en: OpenAI Says Coding Agents Finish Nearly Half of Mid-Length Research Tasks
stories.headline_zh: OpenAI 報告顯示 AI 代理已能獨力完成近半數中等長度研究任務

sentences.en: OpenAI shared a new study about how AI agents help its own engineers.
sentences.zh: OpenAI 分享了一項新研究，說明 AI 代理如何協助自家工程師工作。

sentences.en: These smart coding tools can now finish nearly half of medium-length research tasks alone.
sentences.zh: 這些智慧寫程式工具現在能獨力完成近半數的中等長度研究任務。

sentences.en: The agents are very good at watching test runs and answering technical questions.
sentences.zh: 這些代理特別擅長監控測試執行狀況與回答技術問題。

sentences.en: However, human scientists are still needed to create fresh ideas and check results.
sentences.zh: 然而，發想創新點子與檢查執行結果依然需要人類科學家親自把關。

stories.headline_en: Anthropic Shares Fall Nine Percent Amid Global AI Stock Sell-Off
stories.headline_zh: 全球 AI 類股湧現賣壓 Anthropic 上市次日股價重挫百分之九

sentences.en: Global stock markets dropped on Friday as worries about artificial intelligence companies grew.
sentences.zh: 隨著市場對人工智慧企業的擔憂升高，全球股市在週五出現下跌。

sentences.en: Shares of AI startup Anthropic fell nine percent one day after its huge market debut.
sentences.zh: AI 新創公司 Anthropic 的股價在盛大上市隔天即下跌百分之九。

sentences.en: Many Asian and European stock indexes also closed lower during a difficult trading week.
sentences.zh: 在這個艱難的交易週中，許多亞洲與歐洲股市指數也收在低點。

sentences.en: Analysts say investors are now watching high prices and rising energy costs closely.
sentences.zh: 分析師表示，投資人目前正密切關注過高的股價估值與上漲的能源成本。
